apps.title: Apps to mine
apps.description: Competitor apps: an App Store link or numeric id (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/name/id389801252 or 389801252), or a Google Play link or package name (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music or com.spotify.music).

searchKeywords.title: Find competitor apps by keyword
searchKeywords.description: Optional. Each keyword is searched in the stores and the top apps are mined too (for example 'meditation app').

searchStores.title: Stores to search
searchStores.description: Which stores the keyword search covers: apple, google, or both.

maxAppsPerSearch.title: Apps per keyword and store
maxAppsPerSearch.description: How many top search results are mined for each keyword.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter store countries such as us, gb, de. Each app is read once per country.

language.title: Google Play language
language.description: Language code for Google Play reviews and app details, for example en.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Reviews kept per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap on reviews kept for each app and country, after the filters below. The App Store feed itself only exposes the 500 most recent reviews.

maxRating.title: Keep reviews rated up to (stars)
maxRating.description: 2 keeps 1-star and 2-star reviews (complaints). 5 keeps every rating.

keywords.title: Only reviews mentioning
keywords.description: Optional. Keep only reviews whose title or text contains one of these words or phrases.

recentDays.title: Only reviews from the last N days

minReviewLength.title: Minimum review length (characters)
minReviewLength.description: Title plus text shorter than this is dropped (for example 'bad').

themedOnly.title: Only reviews that match a complaint theme
themedOnly.description: Keeps only reviews with at least one theme (crashes_bugs, login_account, billing_subscription, price_value, ads, performance, ux_design, support, missing_features, privacy_trust, plus your own).

customThemes.title: Your own themes
customThemes.description: Optional. Theme name mapped to a list of words or phrases, for example {"sync": ["sync", "out of sync"]}. A name that already exists adds words to that theme.

includeReviews.title: Return one row per review
includeReviews.description: Off returns only the per-app summary rows with theme counts and example quotes.

maxReviewRows.title: Maximum review rows per run
maxReviewRows.description: Hard cap on review rows in one run.
